title: Formation-first scan of regenerative latent-value fields
objective: Identify large/replenishing actor populations with durable endowment/state disequilibria, repeated connection pressure, partial/informal/expensive flows, recurring missing-edge hypotheses and natural Demand Pumps. Do not start from explicit jobs, gigs, buyer budgets or provider quotes.

formation_zones.name: Cross-generational industrial cognition + AI execution field
formation_zones.shorthand: 厂二代效应去血缘化 / domain-trust × young-digital-execution

actor_population_a.label: retired / senior industry experts and first-generation industrial operators
replenishing_mechanism: ongoing retirement of experienced engineers/managers/technical staff
large-scale succession of first-generation private manufacturing entrepreneurs
accumulated domain knowledge, relationships, credibility and tacit process knowledge remain after full-time role changes

evidence.fact: Jiangsu reports more than 12,000 professional 'silver' talents in economics, technology and management in provincial/local talent pools, with recurring enterprise-request / department-dispatch / expert-accept service.
National old-scientist/engineer enterprise-support programs report about 108,000 older technical workers serving 12,000 enterprises and solving more than 40,000 technical problems.

A 2026 manufacturing report describes a 70+ process expert working with AI engineers to distill decades of tacit operating judgment into AI-usable knowledge because retirement would otherwise risk 'people leave, know-how disappears'.

latent_endowments: ability to distinguish real operational constraints from superficial technical requests
actor_population_a.disequilibrium_hypothesis: High-value tacit industrial cognition remains economically useful after retirement/succession, but current callability is often institution-, relationship- or volunteer-mediated rather than a normal external capability layer.

actor_population_b.label: young AI/digital executors and early-career technical talent
replenishing_mechanism: Jiangsu plans 200,000+ AI technical-skill training instances annually
at least 50,000 AI training instances annually for youth cohorts
AI tools rapidly lower implementation barriers and continuously create new capable executors

evidence.fact: Jiangsu's 2026 AI skills action plans more than 200,000 AI training instances annually, including at least 50,000 for graduates and other youth groups.
Jiangsu training policy and current AI training bases emphasize real enterprise scenes because generic tool knowledge is insufficient.

actor_population_b.disequilibrium_hypothesis: Digital execution capability is growing faster than trusted access to real industrial context, decision authority and domain knowledge.

complementary_node_c.label: traditional SMEs / industrial operators with recurring digital and AI transformation pressure
replenishing_mechanism: AI adoption expanding from pilots toward thousands of factories and enterprises

evidence.fact: A current Nanjing AI industry report says enterprises often do not lack technology or application scenes; they lack people who simultaneously understand business, AI and the scene.
Jiangsu's AI+manufacturing plan explicitly organizes precise matching between AI talent and manufacturing enterprises.
Jiangsu expert-enterprise visits found strong digital/intelligent transformation intent and composite technical-talent gaps in manufacturing firms.

MIIT states AI-era software work raises the value of demand understanding, architecture, integration and validation, while hybrid talent that understands both software and industry knowledge is especially scarce; FDE-type roles are emerging.

observed_connection_pressure.pattern: senior expertise already flows repeatedly into enterprises through silver-expert service teams/workstations
older technical workers nationally already serve thousands of firms and solve tens of thousands of technical problems
young internal teams are already translating AI tooling into operations, safety, procurement and governance inside enterprises
manufacturing succession acts as a natural experiment: when family trust/access is available, younger digitally capable successors can inject new methods into traditional factories

a Jiangsu family-factory example shows an earlier AI platform plan had stalled for lack of professional talent, then a younger family successor with trusted access took ownership of the digital transformation effort

manufacturers are beginning to pair senior tacit process experts with AI engineers to convert decades of difficult-to-articulate shop-floor judgment into model/agent-callable knowledge before retirement

formation_zones.partial_flow_interpretation: Reality already forms the composite through kinship, internal employment, government-organized expert visits, old-expert workstations, youth innovation teams and direct senior-expert × AI-engineer knowledge-extraction projects. These are substitute/partial channels showing directional pressure; they still do not prove one commercial missing edge.
formation_zones.recurring_missing_edge_hypothesis: Two related missing-edge hypotheses remain open: (1) a trusted callable composite of domain cognition + AI/digital execution is difficult to assemble outside kinship/internal/institutional channels; (2) senior tacit industrial know-how is difficult to extract, structure, validate and make callable before retirement because the knowledge holder and AI implementation capability sit in different trust/context systems. Neither is yet OBSERVED as the canonical missing edge.
demand_pump_hypothesis: continuous retirement/succession creates new stranded domain cognition
continuous AI/tool change creates new execution cohorts and new enterprise transformation gaps
recurring SME operating problems create repeated scenes rather than one transaction
each successful composite engagement could create reusable domain patterns, trust and routing history
contradiction_and_incumbent_search: AI consultancies, digital-transformation vendors, FDE-style roles, technical-expert institutions and internal enterprise youth teams may already own much of this edge.
Government/institutional programs may indicate the missing edge is mainly public coordination rather than a private commercial structure.
Senior expertise may be highly idiosyncratic and non-callable; young execution may require too much supervision.
Kinship cases may work specifically because ownership authority/trust cannot be reproduced externally.
If real enterprises simply need full-time composite employees, there may be no separate orchestration layer.
formation_zones.decisive_next_evidence: Distinguish the two hypotheses. Search for repeated current evidence of: (a) firms losing/rehiring senior know-how after retirement; (b) stalled AI/digital projects because implementers cannot understand tacit process context; (c) firms creating ad-hoc senior-expert + young/AI-engineer pairs; (d) family successors acting as trust translators; and (e) whether existing FDE/digital-transformation/knowledge-management vendors already normalize either route. Promote no MISSING_EDGE until one pattern survives contradiction search.

formation_zones.name: Shared manufacturing capacity circulation

evidence.fact: A furniture manufacturer opened surplus welding robots, laser cutters and automatic spraying capacity after digital transformation to improve off-season equipment utilization.

actor_population_b.label: small/micro manufacturers lacking stable capacity or advanced equipment

evidence.fact: Bazhou furniture cluster has 4,000+ firms, more than 80% small/micro, with unstable capacity and uneven equipment levels.

observed_connection_pressure: surplus capacity is publicly quantified and matched to smaller firms by product type and delivery cycle
one factory reportedly served 22 firms, with shared capacity reaching 30%
shared manufacturing has expanded across major clusters and thousands of enterprises
formation_zones.partial_flow: Equipment/capacity sharing is already a real recurring flow, not a hypothetical connection.
formation_zones.demand_pump: order volatility, peak/off-peak capacity mismatch, equipment upgrade asymmetry and recurring production cycles
formation_zones.benchmark_learning: This is a strong canonical example of the target structure: durable surplus + durable deficit + repeated flow + standardizable matching/acceptance + recurring event source. It is primarily a benchmark because the category is already being deliberately institutionalized and platformized.

formation_zones.name: Industrial byproduct / energy circular symbiosis

actor_population_a.label: industrial firms continuously producing byproducts/waste/energy streams
actor_population_a.disequilibrium: disposal/cost/liability on one side can contain recoverable material or energy value

actor_population_b.label: nearby firms/processes that can consume secondary materials, recovered salts, waste heat/energy or other byproduct streams
actor_population_b.disequilibrium: input/resource cost can coexist with nearby stranded secondary-resource output

observed_connection_pressure.fact: Jiangsu explicitly promotes enterprise-to-enterprise waste mutual supply and cascade energy use and describes the need to unblock circular-chain links.
Yangzhou chemical park reports actual upstream/downstream circular chains and describes industrial waste becoming 'flowing wealth' through park-level allocation.

formation_zones.partial_flow: Existing park-level examples already convert waste/byproducts into inputs and recoverable material.
formation_zones.demand_pump: continuous industrial production regenerates both byproduct output and material/energy input demand
formation_zones.benchmark_learning: This is another canonical regenerative field, but the generic connection is already recognized and institutionally organized. Any future business search would need a narrower unresolved recurring edge after regulation/quality/logistics incumbents are considered.

cross_zone_learning: RFZ-002 and RFZ-003 demonstrate what a real regenerative field looks like: the two-sided gradient persists, events recur without founder sales effort, partial flows already exist, and the market/institutions can standardize the missing edge.
RFZ-001 is less formed: evidence for durable populations and connection pressure exists, but the recurring missing edge is still inferred rather than observed.

The correct next move is not to design a 'senior + youth + SME' product. It is to hunt the workaround/failure layer that reveals whether the external composite capability is a real latent connection or merely an attractive narrative.

Family succession is useful as an adjacent natural experiment because kinship supplies trust/access/context. It may reveal which edge an external structure would have to reproduce, but it does not prove that edge can be commercialized.
Explicit job posts, gigs and budgets remain downstream evidence and are not active scan seeds.

The 'people leave, know-how disappears' pattern may be a more fundamental resource-state disequilibrium than generic senior employment: AI changes the economic callability of tacit industrial cognition. This remains a formation hypothesis until recurrence, control and incumbent substitution are audited.
next_action: Deepen RFZ-001 by discriminating two causal/connection hypotheses: trusted cross-generational composite capability versus tacit industrial-knowledge extraction/callability. Search repeated workarounds, retirement knowledge-loss events, stalled AI projects caused by context gaps, ad-hoc senior+young pairings and incumbent FDE/knowledge-management solutions. No product design, buyer search, pricing or outreach.
note: Industrial RFZ-001 remains useful formation evidence, but the current active scan priority is everyday-life intergenerational formation as explicitly requested by the user.
